plants.annotation: plant graph labels; segmentation used for QC only
plants.edge_policy: binary undirected adjacency; exact repeated segment records collapsed, distinct paths retained

octasynth.annotation: supplied projected synthetic vascular graph, retain adjacency; not independently hand-traced skeleton

query_policy: shared capacity >=96, derived from maximum contracted training GT across available source/target datasets; transfers all query slots unchanged
design: B0/Axyz scratch plus B0/Axyz initialized from one common final50-epoch B0 plant checkpoint if source passes; target finetuning has no plant samples
stopping: fixed epochs; stop on nonfinite/error; no automatic extension, sweep or threshold change
